thread:
aj: Pushed a compact Notify Grid + suppression modal update. Short UX/a11y pass please: https://framer.mock/redwood/notify-grid-compact :spiral_note_pad:

mira: Looks much cleaner. One thing: channel names wrap oddly on tablet. Let them wrap and show full name on hover.

devon: Agree on wrap, but surface canonical channel id (muted small text) so engineers can match to infra configs.

samira: Keyboard notes: grid only supports tab now. We should add arrow-key navigation inside the grid (roving tabindex) so users can move between severity cells with arrows.

aj: Plan: implement roving tabindex where arrows move between cells, tab leaves the row. Also add offscreen hint: "Use arrow keys to navigate severities."

mira: Presets need scope indicators (Global / Channel: PagerDuty). Right now it's ambiguous which channels a preset affects.

samira: Color contrast: disabled channel label uses #7a7a7a on white, fails AA for small text. Increase to #5f5f5f or bolder weight.

devon: Suppression input: ditch cron strings. Offer duration (4h 30m) + absolute date-time toggle. Show effective end time in the summary row. Handle overlapping (global + channel) by showing a conflict badge and computed effective end.

aj: Will do. Also switching "Mute" -> "Pause notifications" in CTA copy per previous feedback.

samira: Accessibility smalls: add aria-labels on close buttons, aria-live announce on confirm with end time, and label chips as "P1 selected, toggle to deselect".

mira: One microcopy: change header "Toast" to "Notification preview" and include token placeholders like {{alert.name}} so users can validate templates.

deploy-bot: Reminder: design review with Eng Thu 10:30 AM (updated).

aj: Action items: aj iterate mock + token updates, devon verify policy mapping for overlapping suppressions, samira to re-a11y review, mira to check wrap behavior. Back by EOD Thu. :thumbsup:
